summary: Request temporary H100 quota + benchmark-runner permissions for FP8/INT8 kernel benchmarking sprint (2-week window)
description:
Requester: Talia Benson (Serving Runtime sprint PM)

Request type: Temporary quota + permissions

Business context:
Serving Runtime is running a focused FP8/INT8 kernel benchmarking sprint. We need additional H100 capacity to run the full benchmark matrix (microbench + end-to-end) with pinned driver/CUDA and GPU clocks. Current shared capacity is insufficient to complete the matrix in the sprint window without contending with other jobs.

What we need (quota/capacity):
- H100 GPU quota (temporary) for benchmark clusters only, not customer-serving pools
- Regions/clusters:
  - us-east (primary): +32x H100 GPUs for 6-hour blocks daily
  - us-west (secondary / overflow): +16x H100 GPUs for 4-hour blocks as needed
  - eu-west: optional +8x H100 GPUs for 2 runs to validate regional variance (can be deferred if constrained)
- Time window:
  - Start: 2026-02-11 09:00 PT
  - End: 2026-02-24 18:00 PT
- Estimated total usage:
  - ~1,300 H100 GPU-hours (includes reruns for variance investigation + Nsight trace capture)
- Instance profile / node type:
  - Standard H100-80GB nodes in benchmark-lab pool (no MIG; full GPU access)

Permissions needed:
- Add the following users/service accounts to the benchmark runner allowlist for H100 pool submission:
  - Rina Kobayashi
  - Isabella Rossi
  - Grace Kim
  - svc-benchmark-lab-runner (service account)
- Confirm ability to set GPU clocks (lock to validated ranges) on benchmark nodes.

Guardrails / non-impact constraints (must-haves):
- Do NOT pull from Dedicated customer pools.
- Enforce job scheduling windows to avoid collisions with peak customer demand.
- Enforce max concurrent nodes per submitting user to prevent runaway.
- Tag jobs with "fp8-int8-sprint" for accounting and fast kill switch.

Cost / approval:
- Approved by Neha Kapoor (GPU capacity exec sponsor). See referenced approval thread ("H100 capacity approval for benchmark sprint").

Acceptance criteria:
- Temporary quota available by 2026-02-11 morning PT.
- Runner permissions in place for named owners + service account.
- Explicit expiration / automatic rollback of quota by end date.
- Slack confirmation in #eng-infra and #eng-runtime once enabled.

Notes:
- We had a prior incident (SUP-31867) where benchmarking contended with a Dedicated pool. This request explicitly scopes to benchmark-lab capacity only + guardrails.
